title: Time & Rhythm
reward: Learn that behavior has cadence before it has intent.
knowledge: Separate burst, sustained rate, periodic polling and isolated events.
Compare behavior within service and time context; global averages can mislead.
Deploy, reboot, backup, health-check and cache warmup can create legitimate bursts.
A short spike is not a flood verdict; duration and resource effect matter.
New-day evidence is stronger for stability than repeated same-day reruns.
challenge: Describe one burst without calling it hostile.
Identify a recurring rhythm from evidence while retaining an alternative explanation.
next_requires: Demonstrate temporal context without converting rate into guilt.
